title: One Second Away | KEY.co
description_expanded: Seven beautifully appointed bedrooms, seven full bathrooms, and two half baths provide generous space for large groups while maintaining privacy and comfort. The third-floor primary suite offers a serene retreat with vaulted ceilings, a private porch, and sweeping Gulf vistas, while additional living spaces throughout the home create inviting spots to unwind. A separate carriage house adds an extra layer of privacy with its own bedroom, kitchenette, and bath. Located just about a mile from Seaside and moments from the sugar-white sand, the home places the best of 30A within easy reach—from acclaimed dining and boutique shopping to world-class fishing and emerald-green waters. With a six-seater golf cart and six bikes included, this exceptional coastal residence makes exploring the area as effortless as enjoying the view. Perched in the heart of Seagrove Beach, One Second Away showcases breathtaking Gulf of Mexico views and elevated coastal design just steps from the shoreline. This striking luxury retreat features a second-floor heated pool overlooking the water, expansive outdoor living spaces, and multiple gathering areas designed for relaxation and connection. With an elevator for easy access to all three levels, a private carriage house, and ample parking, every detail of the home reflects thoughtful craftsmanship and effortless comfort. The stunning great room on the second floor opens to panoramic Gulf views and flows seamlessly into a chef’s kitchen outfitted with a Wolf gas range, Sub-Zero refrigeration, dual dishwashers, and an oversized island perfect for entertaining.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
